cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(sh3_moltenvk_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
foreach(key IN ITEMS SH3_VULKAN_INCLUDE SH3_MVK_INCLUDE SH3_MVK_LIBRARY
                     SH3_SHADERC_INCLUDE SH3_SHADERC_LIBRARY SH3_CROSS_SOURCE SH3_CROSS_LIBRARY)
    if(NOT ${key} OR NOT EXISTS "${${key}}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Set ${key} to an explicit existing path")
    endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_VULKAN_INCLUDE}/vulkan/vulkan.h" OR
   NOT EXISTS "${SH3_MVK_INCLUDE}/MoltenVK/mvk_private_api.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Explicit roots do not contain required Vulkan/MoltenVK headers")
endif()
add_library(MV SHARED IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(MV PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${SH3_MVK_LIBRARY}"
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${SH3_VULKAN_INCLUDE};${SH3_MVK_INCLUDE}")
add_library(SC SHARED IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(SC PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${SH3_SHADERC_LIBRARY}"
    INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${SH3_SHADERC_INCLUDE}"
    INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS SHADERC_SHAREDLIB)
add_executable(mv_consumer consumer.cpp)
target_compile_features(mv_consumer PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(mv_consumer PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-missing-field-initializers)
target_compile_definitions(mv_consumer PRIVATE SH3_EXPECTED_MVK="${SH3_MVK_LIBRARY}")
target_link_libraries(mv_consumer PRIVATE MV)
add_executable(mv_shader shader.cpp)
target_compile_features(mv_shader PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(mv_shader PRIVATE SC)
add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/compute.spv"
    COMMAND mv_shader "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/compute.spv"
    DEPENDS mv_shader VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(mv_spirv ALL DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/compute.spv")
enable_testing()
foreach(case IN ITEMS profile errors transfer compute image)
    add_test(NAME mv_${case} COMMAND mv_consumer ${case} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/compute.spv")
    set_tests_properties(mv_${case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
endforeach()
# Original SPIRV-Cross test sources and inputs stay in the private checkout.
add_library(cross_c_api STATIC "${SH3_CROSS_SOURCE}/spirv_cross_c.cpp")
target_include_directories(cross_c_api PUBLIC "${SH3_CROSS_SOURCE}")
target_compile_features(cross_c_api PRIVATE cxx_std_14)
target_compile_definitions(cross_c_api PRIVATE SPIRV_CROSS_NAMESPACE_OVERRIDE=MVK_spirv_cross)
target_compile_definitions(cross_c_api PRIVATE SPIRV_CROSS_C_API_MSL=1 SPIRV_CROSS_C_API_GLSL=1)
target_link_libraries(cross_c_api PUBLIC "${SH3_CROSS_LIBRARY}")
foreach(case IN ITEMS small_vector msl_constexpr_test msl_resource_bindings)
    add_executable(provider_${case} "${SH3_CROSS_SOURCE}/tests-other/${case}.cpp")
    target_compile_features(provider_${case} PRIVATE cxx_std_14)
    target_compile_options(provider_${case} PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    target_link_libraries(provider_${case} PRIVATE cross_c_api)
    if(case STREQUAL "small_vector")
        add_test(NAME provider_${case} COMMAND provider_${case})
    elseif(case STREQUAL "msl_constexpr_test")
        add_test(NAME provider_${case} COMMAND provider_${case} "${SH3_CROSS_SOURCE}/tests-other/msl_constexpr_test.spv")
    else()
        add_test(NAME provider_${case} COMMAND provider_${case} "${SH3_CROSS_SOURCE}/tests-other/msl_resource_binding.spv")
    endif()
    set_tests_properties(provider_${case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
endforeach()
